check_environment.title: Check environment configuration
check_environment.description: Running the general environment checks that apply to any Wine problem.

check_processes.title: Check running Wine processes
check_processes.description: Looking at what is currently running in this bottle, which narrows down where the problem can be.

gather_details.title: Gather details
gather_details.description: This problem does not match one of the guided categories. The most useful next step is a diagnostics export: it bundles the findings above with the relevant logs so the issue can be looked at properly.

escalate.title: Additional diagnostics needed
escalate.description: The general checks did not point at a specific cause. Export a session report to capture the evidence.

resolved.title: Problem resolved
resolved.description: The issue has been fixed. You can export a session report for your records.
